title_en: Guide to Course Registration for the 2026 Academic Year Winter Session
summary: The department announces course registration for the 2026 Academic Year Winter Session. Students who wish to take winter session courses should read the attached files and register according to the schedule given there.
applies_to: Students who wish to apply for the winter session (동계 계절학기).
steps: Read the attached files carefully, in particular Attachment 1-1, which contains the registration guide. These attachments were not read for this translation, and the schedule is not given in the notice text.
Register for winter session courses according to the schedule in the attached files.
translation:
Title: Guide to Course Registration for the 2026 Academic Year Winter Session (2026학년도 동계 계절수업 수강신청 안내)
Posted: 2026-10-19

The department announces the course registration schedule for the 2026 Academic Year Winter Session. Students who wish to apply for the winter session should read the attached files carefully and register according to the schedule.

1. Schedule
2. Points to Note

[Translator's note: The notice text contains only these two headings. It gives no schedule details and no points to note. This information appears to be in the attached files, which were not read for this translation. Please consult the attachments or the original notice.]

Attachment 1-1. Guide to Course Registration for the 2026 Academic Year Winter Session
Attachment 1-2. Seoul National University Course Registration System User Manual (Korean/English)
Attachment 1-3. Card news on the improved course registration system to prevent the selling of course places
Attachment 2. Notice on misconduct in course registration
Attachment 3. Guide to duplicate course registration requests

Attached files (5). None of these files were read for this translation:
- (붙임1-1) 2026학년도 동계 계절수업 수강신청 안내 (Guideline for 2026 Winter Session Course Registration).pdf
- (붙임1-2) 서울대학교 수강신청 시스템 이용자 매뉴얼(국영문) (Course Registration System User Manual, Korean/English).pdf
- (붙임1-3) 강의매매방지 수강신청제도 개선 카드뉴스 (New CRS Program for Preventing Reselling).pdf
- (붙임2) 수강신청 부정행위 관련 알림 (Notice on Course Registration Misconduct).pdf
- (붙임3) 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 (Course Overlap Request Manual).pdf
